questions.q: Sunil is the son of Pooja. Neha is the daughter of Pooja. Ajay is the husband of Neha. How is Ajay related to Sunil?
questions.why: Draw the family tree from the statements; the answer is Brother-in-law. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: The present ages of Asha and Pooja are in the ratio 3 : 2. After 10 years the ratio will be 14 : 11. What is Pooja's present age?
questions.why: Let the ages be 3k and 2k: (3k + 10)/(2k + 10) = 14/11 gives k = 6, so Pooja is 12. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If POTENCY is written as ZDOFUPQ in a certain code, how is SILVER written in that code?
questions.why: In the code each letter moves 1 place forward and the word is then reversed: SILVER → SFWMJT. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: In a group of 40 people, 17 like Konkani, 19 like Marathi and 11 like neither. How many like only Konkani?
questions.why: Both = 17 + 19 − (40 − 11) = 7; only Konkani = 17 − 7 = 10. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: If 28 January 2027 was a Thursday, what day of the week was 17 March 2027?
questions.why: 48 days later; 48 mod 7 = 6, so count 6 days on from Thursday. GPSC-style practice item.

questions.q: Sam bought 20 dozen toys at ₹375 a dozen and sold each toy for ₹33. What was his profit per cent?
questions.why: Cost per toy 375 ÷ 12 = 31.25; profit 1.75; 1.75 ÷ 31.25 = 5.6%. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2025.

questions.q: People speculate when they assume something to be true on inconclusive evidence. Which is the best example of speculation?
opts: Francine wears jeans on Friday after reading about 'Casual Fridays' in her employee handbook
Mary sits in traffic and wishes she had taken the train
After consulting guidebooks and her travel agent, Jennifer is confident her hotel is first-rate
When Emily opens the door in tears, Theo guesses she has had a death in the family
questions.why: Only Theo concludes from thin evidence. GPSC CBRT, Sep 2024.

questions.q: A man is facing north. He turns right and walks 20 m, turns right again and walks 20 m, then turns left and walks 10 m. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.why: North, then right to east, right to south, and left back to east.

questions.q: Raju walks 20 m west, turns left and walks 20 m, turns left and walks 20 m, turns left again and walks 20 m. Which direction is he facing?
questions.why: West → left = South → left = East → left = North. GPSC CBRT, Jun 2025.
